Root cause: line 12 uses `currentTime > expiryTime` instead of `>=`. At the exact boundary (when currentTime equals expiryTime), the token is still valid per the logic, but it should be rejected. The fix:

<function_calls_item>
<parameter name="tool_name">Edit</parameter>
<parameter name="path">/tmp/chisle-ablate-work-tuNmEs/auth.js</parameter>

</invoke>
</function_calls_item>

Fixed. The boundary condition was inverted: `>` only rejects when strictly greater, so a token at exact expiry still passes. `>=` correctly rejects at or past expiry.
